headline: Charges mask underlying strength as EPS guidance rises
summary_short: Third-quarter net sales rose 1% year-over-year to $1,172.1 million, but GAAP diluted EPS fell 25% to $1.90 as a $47.0 million impairment and restructuring charge weighed on operating income. Adjusted diluted EPS of $2.82 rose 8%, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $4.30-$4.45.
summary_long: Net sales rose 1% y/y to $1,172.1M (down 20% q/q on seasonal spring rolloff); gross margin fell 90bps to 31.2% on higher freight/commodity costs tied to the Iran conflict. A $47.0M impairment and restructuring charge (versus a $1.0M credit last year) drove GAAP operating income down 24% and GAAP diluted EPS down 25% to $1.90. Non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations rose 8% to $2.82 on Bonnie Plants JV strength and a lower tax rate; net leverage improved to 3.78x, 0.37x better y/y. Long-term debt fell 14% y/y to $1,836.3M; shareholders' deficit widened to -$208.7M. Full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $4.30-$4.45 (from $4.15-$4.35); other FY2026 targets reaffirmed.

drivers.explanation: Company frames the quarter as on-track execution of its multi-year plan, with disciplined cost management supporting a raised full-year adjusted EPS outlook despite one-time charges.
Margin contraction attributed to higher freight and commodity costs tied to the Iran conflict, partly offset by supply-chain automation, AI use, and purchasing efficiencies.
